newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shekel weakens against dollar, basket.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shekel weakens against dollar, basket.

text.p: The Israeli shekel weakened against the dollar and the basket of key foreign currencies on Wednesday in quiet trading, despite the decline of the dollar abroad, dealers said.

"Trading was very dull and mixed today. The dollar moved in a very narrow range. The shekel did not rise against the dollar despite the decline of the U.S. currency in the markets abroad," said a dealer at United Mizrahi Bank.
He attributed that to a single big transaction during the day in which shekels were converted into dollars.

The representative rate for the dollar was fixed at 3.2860 shekels against 3.2820 shekels on Tuesday. The basket, composed of the dollar, mark, pound sterling, French franc and yen, was fixed at 3.6750 shekels against 3.6620 on Tuesday.
On the crosses the shekel traded against the yen at 2.9139 shekels per 100 yen against 2.8988 on Tuesday and against the mark at 2.1299 shekels against 2.1120 on Tuesday.
In late afternoon the dollar was trading at 3.2870 shekels.
